title: Socially Woke signed portable object envelope v1
description: Structural interchange schema for every Socially Woke v1 portable object and its Ed25519 proof.
$comment: JSON Schema validates transport structure. Implementations MUST also apply RFC 8785 canonicalization, signature/hash verification, UTF-8 byte limits, cross-field refinements, intrinsic signing rules, and current external authorization policy from the protocol library.
